test_migration_creates_clean_uuid_ids: test that migration creates programs with clean UUID IDs instead of _migrant suffixes
test_multiple_migration_rounds_no_expone: test that multiple migration rounds do not cause exponential program growth across islands
test_migrated_program_content_preserved: test that migrated programs preserve their original code and metrics after migration
test_migration_target_islands_are_differ: test that programs migrate to different islands rather than staying on the same island
test_no_duplicate_program_ids_across_all: test that no program ID appears in multiple islands simultaneously after migration
